notes.title: SPYHACK is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Spies! [/h1]

[b]SPYHACK: Episode 1[/b] is now available on Steam! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/687340/SPYHACK_Episode_1/]Play NOW[/url] and become a secret agent of the Advanced Technology Division to protect humanity from self-destruction!

[url= Advanced Technology Division and protect humanity from self-destruction!][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/b87d1f555da8647161954d197dd2ac50a664b9c6.png[/img][/url]

To celebrate SpyHack release on Steam, we have a small surprise for you on our [url=https://discord.gg/dkwz4H3pgH]Discord server[/url], so be sure to to join us! 

[url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url] 

If you encounter bugs, please report them on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/687340/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh]Discord server[/url]. 

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/spyhack-switch/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/2f315b41b3f917d984c518d23180ef1ee5b2c3a8.png[/img][/url]

Remember that you can also play the full version of this game on [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/spyhack-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]!

Play now and have fun! 
SpyHack Team 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/687340/SPYHACK_Episode_1/

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:

[b]We are happy to announce that SpyHack is coming to Steam on 4th of December![/b] Get ready to become a secret agent of the Advanced Technology Division and protect humanity from self-destruction! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/b87d1f555da8647161954d197dd2ac50a664b9c6.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Spies![/h1]

[b]The Steam game festival starts today:  Oct 7th, and will last up to Oct 13th![/b] If you haven’t tried out SpyHack Demo yet, you do this now! Play the demo and have fun! 

[b]SpyHack Demo[/b] is a small introduction to the world ruled by unethical technocorporations. Become a secret agent and protect humanity from self-destruction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/b53b02c0273853c26441c73d4d6648841168016f.jpg[/img]

[h3]How to download a demo?[/h3]

You will be able to download the demo from our Steam Page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/687340/SPYHACK_Episode_1/]SpyHack steam store page[/url]. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/687340/SPYHACK_Episode_1/


During the Steam Game Festival, you may expect a stream with chat and more! 
More information will follow in a few days so stay tuned! ːsteamhappyː

SpyHack Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/938110dec635bbbb24a7edc43d13a925d27a684b.png[/img]

notes.title: Open beta tests!
notes.content:
[b]We are launching SPYHACK: Episode 1 Open Beta Tests subscription![/b]

In order to participate in the open beta you need to:
[list]
[*] Follow the game on Steam
[*] Add the game to WishList on Steam
[*] Submit your email in the form: https://goo.gl/forms/NCGnyNWAfbXVa00u2
[/list]
